rationale: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian ships in Libya and Gulf of Finland demonstrate expanded operational reach; Russian strikes on Kyiv region continue known pattern.

top_events.title: Suspected drone attack causes explosion on Russian ship in Libya
top_events.label: Ukraine strikes Russian ship Libya port
top_events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at Libya's Benghazi naval base. The vessel had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

top_events.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
top_events.label: Russian strikes collapse Kyiv region building
top_events.summary: A residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region collapsed after Russian strikes. Rescue teams are searching for missing residents amid ongoing danger.

top_events.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
top_events.label: Ukraine hits Russian ship Gulf Finland
top_events.summary: Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on a Russian vessel in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday. The damaged ship was towed away from the area.

most_significant_event.label: Russian double-tap strike kills 72 rescuers
most_significant_event.summary: Russia deliberately targets rescue workers with follow-up strikes in southern Ukraine, killing 72 and hampering body recovery. Intensified attacks on civilian responders.
most_significant_event.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
